old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-gyo1","title":"Label parser-only signed-frame fixture as cryptographically invalid","description":"Security review found spec/test-vectors/frame.json names frame_with_signature a signed frame with a Schnorr-48 MIC, but its 48 bytes are a repeated 0x55 placeholder and the artifact supplies no public key/transcript or explicit parser-only validity marker. Python and Rust tests accept it as a structurally valid parsed frame and never verify the signature. Although test/vectors/link_frame.json contains real independent signatures, the spec-level fixture can be mistaken for an authentication-positive vector and normalize treating S=1 plus 48 bytes as authenticated. Mark this case explicitly structural/parser-only with authentication_expected=false (or replace it with an independently valid signature and key metadata), and make consumer tests assert that parsing is not authentication; retain independent negative verification coverage for invalid 48-byte MICs.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T13:28:35.397985Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T13:28:35.397985Z"}
